facts.activity_file: charging, tying in and guarding a blast

control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: thermal release during cleaning and preparation on MAG-9602

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on MAG-9602 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. MAG-9602 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 March 2005 an incident occurred on MAG-9602 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
